title: Fort Bedford Museum

services.name: Admission
services.desc: This exhibit features a deeper look at Bedford's role during the French & Indian War. In addition to local artifacts, there is a model of a pre-revolutionary steel forge. Featuring Eve's deer-skin-covered trunk, used in her return to the area. Generously donated by the heirs of Jill Eichelberger Bailey. Believed to be the only original Fort Bedford flag from 1758 still in existence. This unique British military ensign was preserved through regional families. Curated from over 5,000 artifacts, this exhibit provides a glimpse into the culture of Bedford as it developed along the Forbes Road. Highlights include weapons, housewares, and fiber
